notes.title: Announcing the Narcissu 10th Anniversary Anthology Project
notes.content:
Let's revisit the seventh floor and complete this amazing visual novel series about life and death, those leaving and those left behind. Since before 2010, fans have been asking for translations of the rest of the Narcissu series, and now on the 10th anniversary of the first game, we're finally able to make it happen!

http://prefundia.com/projects/view/narcissu-10th-anniversary-anthology-project/6803/

notes.title: Ame no Marginal heading to Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]The latest visual novel from Tomo Kataoka, the creator of acclaimed free visual novel [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/264380/]Narcissu[/url], will be brought to Steam by Sekai Project![/h1]

A serious visual novel telling the story of a man who steps into an elevator, only to find himself transported to a strange and mysterious world.

In this world, there is no time, no aging, no hunger, not even death. There is nothing to be seen but weathered stone, white clouds, and endless rain.

[url=https://marginal.sekaiproject.com/]Ame no Marginal now available for pre-order[/url]!

notes.title: May 11th 2014 patch notes for Narcissu 1st & 2nd
notes.content:
This update only updates the engine and does not touch the game script files so saves should not be harmed.

Bugs fixed: 

[url=https://github.com/sekaiproject/ponscripter-fork/issues/28]#28[/url] - Workaround for bug in SDL2 regarding maximizing the game, minimizing the game, and then restoring the game.

[url=https://github.com/sekaiproject/ponscripter-fork/issues/29]#29[/url], [url=https://github.com/sekaiproject/ponscripter-fork/issues/59]#59[/url],[url=https://github.com/sekaiproject/ponscripter-fork/issues/60]#60[/url], [url=https://github.com/sekaiproject/ponscripter-fork/issues/61]#61[/url] - Making the game less picky about mouse click detection to fix reported issues

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Narcissu 1st & 2nd
notes.content:
Narcissu 1st & 2nd is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

This is a story of disease and suffering; of medication and adverse effects; of thoracotomy scars and cellular poisons; of the living who cannot help but to die and of the dying who cannot help but to live; of a resting place other than "on 7F" or "at home".
